name: icon-cloud
title: Icon Cloud
blurb: 3D rotating cloud of icons or images rendered on canvas.
description: Interactive canvas component rendering a rotating globe of icons or image URLs. Responds to mouse drag with momentum animation and smooth rotation.
use_when: Tech stacks, skill showcases, or logo clouds for portfolios and landing pages.
avoid_when: When icon accessibility is critical, or on devices with limited GPU.
a11y: Canvas-rendered; no semantic structure or keyboard interaction. Purely visual.
